title: How to price a product: a simple pricing strategy with AI
seoTitle: How to price a product, with AI to do the sums
description: How to price a product, step by step. Count every cost, check value and rival prices, try tiers and test a price increase, with AI doing the sums.
lede: Here is how to price a product: calculate your floor from every cost of a sale, then estimate your ceiling from what buyers value. Next, test a price between the two on a small, controlled scale. This guide covers each step, with prompts that let your AI model the scenarios and a safe way to test a price increase.
